verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is purpose-built for instant, typo-tolerant, millisecond full-text search with ranking rules, and community reports corroborate real-world speed (10x faster indexing/search than Elasticsearch, sub-second at scale) even though some users note RAM/write scaling issues under heavy load. Docs explicitly market 'instant' typo-tolerant search with no tuning required, and hands-on reports confirm fast search at production scale. missing for 10: no explicit documented millisecond latency benchmark or as-you-type debounce guidance, and some community reports of indexing lag/RAM unpredictability under heavy write load temper full confidence.
